payload.title: A module grant carries no role: user_module_assignments has no role column, the per-module manager choice is stored only as isPrimaryManager which token mint never reads, and the JWT carries the tenant-wide users.role plus a role-less list of module codes, so a manager of one module is a manager of every module
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/entities/user-module-assignment.entity.ts:62-83 (only isPrimaryManager and an unused permissions jsonb; no role column)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-admin.service.ts:361-368 (a per-module manager choice is stored as isPrimaryManager)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/services/token.service.ts:563-575 (assignments mapped to code, name and route; isPrimaryManager dropped)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/services/token.service.ts:370-377 (role and roles from users.role; modules a bare list of codes)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/services/token.service.ts:593-599 (users.role MODULE_MANAGER lifts the site restriction in every module)
libs/backend-common/src/decorators/roles.decorator.ts:36-42 (MODULE_MANAGER documented as manager of a single module, yet stored tenant-wide)
payload.rule_violated: Plan section 2 target model (claim moduleAccess maps each module to MODULE_MANAGER or MODULE_USER; users.role becomes an account role only) and owner decisions D2 and D5
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-04, release R1.
